name: Door Frame Controller
description: Placing the controller as part of a door frame will let you lock the door when closed, and check whether the door is closed enough to be forming a seal. Only one controller should be placed per frame.
shortDescription: Controller unit for sealing door frames.

logicNodes.label: Lock Seal
logicNodes.description: Controls if the door panel will lock in place when sealed.

logicNodes.label: Seal State
logicNodes.description: Indicates if the door panel is closed and forming a seal.
